notes.title: Changelogs #25.07.30 - Alpha
notes.content: [h1]Changelogs #25.07.30[/h1][p][/p][p]With this patch, we are adding our newest weapon, Heavy Machine Gun (HMG), and making a change to our Team Deathmatch mode, turning it into a (FFA) Deathmatch to allow a small and uneven number of players to enjoy the game without having to “sit” and wait for others. Aside from that, we revisited some existing maps to reduce their gameplay frustrations and made a few other minor adjustments.[/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Disabled dodges resetting your vertical velocity and using a lower gravity in favour of keeping your existing vertical velocity and using regular gravity, allowing you to jump and dodge instantly for tricks without having to wait for the peak[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Game Modes[/h3][p]Team Deathmatch:[/p][list][*][p]Disabled until further notice[/p][/*][/list][p]Deathmatch:[/p][list][*][p]Added with a limit of 6 players and only a time limit of 15 minutes until we decide on a score limit as well[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Animations[/h3][list][*][p]Slightly improved left and right walljump animations[/p][/*][*][p]Switched to a new forward jump style, adding a side flip to start[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons[/h3][p]Heavy Machine Gun (Item: Wildfire)[/p][list][*][p]Added the weapon with placeholder VFX and SFX[/p][/*][*][p]LMB has a fire rate of 12 bullets per second, with each dealing 8 damage, with a similar drop off to Swordgun[/p][/*][*][p]RMB goes into awakened state as long as you keep holding it, initially doing an explosion attack around you for 12 damage while transforming and then starts to shoot[/p][/*][*][p]RMB’s awakened shooting has a fire rate of 16 bullets per second with double the spread on X axis with each dealing 6 damage and pushing enemies back (does not stack)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i0.wp.com/news.codezin.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/hmg-1.png?resize=953%2C440&ssl=1"][/img][/p][p]Bat (Item: Cyclone)[/p][list][*][p]Added trail effect for normal and spin attacks, in addition to a new VFX for the spin attack[/p][/*][/list][p]Swordgun (Item: Scorpio)[/p][list][*][p]Changed the bullet pattern from a random position of 90-degree slice of a circle to the full circle all around the crosshair[/p][/*][/list][p]Rifle Cannon (Item: Helios)[/p][list][*][p]Fixed explosions not critting behind a cover (done between patches as a quick server fix, now applying to clients as well)[/p][/*][/list][p]Broadsword (Item: Durendal / Founder's Sword)[/p][list][*][p]Changed the strong cut to keep the vertical speed on the jump pads[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Maps[/h3][p]Outer Space:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the majority of the balcony on top of the goal posts, only leaving a small extension[/p][/*][*][p]Switched the goal post to a version without side walls to prevent blocking the entrance without jumping[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the lighting to be brighter[/p][/*][/list][p]Ironworks:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the majority of the tiny ledges, which caused inconsistent results on jumps[/p][/*][*][p]Made some ramps slide better without getting stuck on corners (Experimental)[/p][/*][/list][p]Service Point:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the railings from the  central area, making it easier to climb out of the bottom with walljumps[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Client[/h3][list][*][p]Added more weapons to HUB[/p][/*][*][p]Changed character shader to exaggerate received lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Changed walljump effect (WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some weapon textures to match their designs better, mostly on colours[/p][/*][*][p]Changed weapon shaders to match player ones[/p][/*][/list][p]Note: Dissolve timings have changed as a side effect of this change; we will retime them along with player dissolve at a later date.[/p][p][/p][h3]Server[/h3][list][*][p]Implemented fallback for custom hitbox rollbacks in case there isn’t enough accumulated data yet (done between patches to fix forever ghost notes.title: Short-Term and Mid-Term (around 4weeks) Update Plan
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First, thank you all for playing our game and giving us valuable feedback! Since this Steam Early Access release, you have found many things for us to fix and improve, and once again provided us with what you want us to focus on first.

We want to tackle everything, but of course, it won't all be done right away. So here are our focus topics that we want to handle now:

1. Bug fixes
2. Gameplay experience
3. Onboarding for new players
4. Content

They are in order of how fast we can ship them to you, but that doesn't mean we will wait for one to get started on another. For instance, for the next patch we want to release (which we expect to go live early to mid next week):

- [Bug fix] Ironworks map fixes
- [Bug fix] Missed input drop fix
- [Gameplay experience] Overall weapon balancing (this is an ongoing one for the future as well)
- [Gameplay experience] Improved weapon switching
- [Gameplay experience] Additional hit sounds to improve hit feedback, starting with guns
- [Gameplay experience] Turning Touchdown player limit from 5v5 to 4v4 to reduce chaos

For mid-term (mostly within a month, but content creation usually takes a while), we have other things in mind, like:

- [Content] Resuming work on Bat weapon
- [Bug fix] Preventing dead players from stopping dashes
- [Gameplay experience] More distinction on melee hits to improve hit feedback
- [Onboarding for new players] Weapon information in the inventory
- [Gameplay experience] Showcasing possible shots left out of total for the current weapon flux (energy) in HUD
- [Gameplay experience] Showcasing when and which animation cancel you can do with an icon in the HUD
- [Gameplay experience] Input buffering for animation cancels
- [Onboarding for new players] A basic Tutorial, one that gets the core mechanics across
- [Content] Adding Heavy Machine Gun weapon

Of course, there will be more to come, and as is normal in game development, we might have to adjust some plans along the way. Still, we hope this gives you the gist of our current focus: improving the game.

notes.title: Code ZIN Early Access is live - Alpha
notes.content:
Hello,

Finally, we released Code ZIN on Steam as Early Access in a state we would describe as an Alpha. So, it is not a fully polished EA title with "just" content missing. We want to gather your feedback early on!

During this Early Access, we will add more content and improve animations, UI, etc. As stated in the FAQ, we need to polish and improve things. We want to do this with you, so we focus on the right things. 

So far, we have two modes (Team Deathmatch and Touchdown), five weapons, two skills and four maps included.

We are happy to see you in-game and await your feedback to improve the game together.

Finally, we can tell you the exact date. On May 27th, we will release the game in Early Access as a paid version for 10 USD with exclusive items.

For the upcoming Early Access Launch, we plan to have servers in the US and in Europe (France). If we see during Early Access that many Asian players join we will add a Singapore Server quickly as well.

notes.content:
Hello,

We finally released Touchdown for our Alpha (buyable [url=https://codezin.com/]here[/url]). With this step, we are now focussing on our Steam Early Access Release. 

Besides the Steam integration itself, our focus will be to update as many animations as possible and smoothen the gameplay experience in general

[previewyoutube=9Cqozk4pTzs;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy the trailer!

notes.title: Small Weekend Update
notes.content:
Some weekend news: 

Touchdown mode is getting closer, and we're working on the last map changes and finishing our short animation trailer. After that, we will work on our Early Access release here on Steam. So far you can play the Alpha via https://codezin.com/ 

We finally have over 3k members on our Discord https://discord.gg/codezin. Feel free to join!

Have a great weekend, Zinners!

notes.title: Alpha is out. Early Access will follow
notes.content:
Our Alpha version was released at [url=https://www.codezin.com/]www.codezin.com[/url] Steam Early Access will follow as soon as possible, as we want to polish some things first and add a bit more content. 

If you can not wait, we welcome everyone to our Alpha.

So we get closer!
